x-card.description: A SQLite database file on this computer. Read queries and schema.

connection.title: Database file
connection.description: GateRook opens the file on this computer: reads through a read-only handle, approved changes through their own. It never creates a file.

file.title: Database file
file.description: An absolute path or ~/…, such as ~/projects/shop/db/development.sqlite3. Only you choose the file: an AI import can't.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Timeouts, locking, foreign keys and the pool. Policies can tighten limits per environment.

statementTimeoutMs.title: Statement timeout
statementTimeoutMs.description: GateRook interrupts slower statements. Empty: the environment policy.

busyTimeoutMs.title: Lock wait
busyTimeoutMs.description: How long a call waits while another program writes to the file.

foreignKeys.title: Enforce foreign keys
foreignKeys.description: SQLite checks the file's foreign keys, and runs their ON DELETE and ON UPDATE actions, on approved changes, as most apps that use them do.
